description: This file is a shell script library used for CVS import tests, which includes setup functions, environment checks, and comparison utilities for testing CVS and git repositories.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository by copying CVS root data.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out a CVS module for a specified branch.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out a branch in a Git repository.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares a specific file between CVS and Git branches.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares entire directory trees from CVS and git for a given branch.
